title: michelia griffithii
intro: Michelia griffithii, commonly known as White Magnolia or Yulan Magnolia, is a flowering plant species native to China. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory health, and acting as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Michelia griffithii include its use as an expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and volatile oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
